face.name: 复活宠物
face.text: 发现一只在本局对战中死亡的友方野兽，并召唤该随从。
face.flavorText: 最好的朋友其实从未远离。

face.name: Revive Pet
face.text: Discover a friendly Beast that died this game. Summon it.
face.flavorText: Best friends never really leave.

face.name: 野性之魂
face.text: 召唤两个不同的休眠灵种。使你的灵种提前1回合唤醒。
face.flavorText: 这是张刚刚发布的新卡牌，没那么狂野！所以它应该是标准之魂！

face.name: Wild Spirits
face.text: Summon two different Dormant Wildseeds. Make your Wildseeds awaken 1 turn sooner.
face.flavorText: Wait, this card just released! It should be Standard Spirits!

face.name: 螺壳射击
face.text: 随机对一个敌方随从造成 3点伤害。重复此效果，每次伤害减少1点。
face.flavorText: 精度胜于准度。

face.name: Shellshot
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion. Repeat this with 1 less damage.
face.flavorText: Precision over accuracy.

face.name: 狐灵之种
face.text: 休眠1回合。 突袭

face.name: Fox Spirit Wildseed
face.text: Dormant for 1 turn. Rush

face.name: 熊灵之种
face.text: 休眠2回合。嘲讽

face.name: Bear Spirit Wildseed
face.text: Dormant for 2 turns. Taunt

face.name: 鹿灵之种
face.text: 休眠3回合。唤醒时，装备一把4/2的巨弓。

face.name: Stag Spirit Wildseed
face.text: Dormant for 3 turns. When this awakens, equip a 4/2 Greatbow.

face.name: 腐蚀吐息
face.text: 对一个随从造成 3点伤害。如果你的手牌中有龙牌，还会命中敌方英雄。
face.flavorText: 来一口新鲜的恐惧！

face.name: Corrosive Breath
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If you're holding a Dragon, it also hits the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: It's a breath of fresh terror!

face.name: 眼镜蛇射击
face.text: 对一个随从和敌方英雄造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 戴眼镜的蛇当然会瞄的更准一点。

face.name: Cobra Shot
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: "Cobra Shot" hurts way, way, way more than "Cobra Cuddle."

face.name: 剧毒箭矢
face.text: 对一个随从造成 2点伤害，如果它依然存活，则使其获得剧毒。
face.flavorText: 熬过痛苦，你就会更狠毒。

face.name: Toxic Arrow
face.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it survives, give it Poisonous.
face.flavorText: What doesn't kill you makes you toxic.

face.name: 小型法术翡翠
face.text: 召唤两只3/3的狼。（使用一个奥秘后升级。）
face.flavorText: “牛头人得到了这块绿色的石头，想要用它的力量拯救自己的土地。他们释放了心中的怒火，族群却从此失落。究竟谁是猎手，谁又是野兽？”——《魔石》

face.name: Lesser Emerald Spellstone
face.text: Summon two 3/3 Wolves. (Play a Secret to upgrade.)
face.flavorText: An emerald stone for Tauren hands Who sought its strength to save their lands Their tribes now lost, their rage released Who’s hunting now? And who’s the beast?

face.name: 寄生感染
face.text: 使你的所有随从获得 “亡语：随机将一张野兽牌置入你的手牌”。
face.flavorText: 作为寄生虫最有趣的一刻就是破肚而出时吓宿主一跳……好吧，他们已经是死人了。

face.name: Infest
face.text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Add a random Beast to your hand."
face.flavorText: The best part is the look on their face when you jump out of the cake! Err… corpse.

face.name: 眼镜蛇射击
face.text: 对一个随从和敌方英雄造成 3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 戴眼镜的蛇当然会瞄的更准一点。

face.name: Cobra Shot
face.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: "Cobra Shot" hurts way, way, way more than "Cobra Cuddle."

face.name: 法术翡翠
face.text: 召唤三只3/3的狼。（使用一个奥秘后升级。）

face.name: Emerald Spellstone
face.text: Summon three 3/3 Wolves. (Play a Secret to upgrade.)

face.name: 大型法术翡翠
face.text: 召唤四只3/3的狼。

face.name: Greater Emerald Spellstone
face.text: Summon four 3/3 Wolves.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

policies.pet: Original friendly at-death controller; existing printed-death Beast query, group by original card identity with one unit weight and retain first matching original DeathRecord; common sample_size=3 CARD_DISCOVERY and attributed ResurrectMinion.
policies.wildseeds: Complete three named printed minions; common attributed GenerateFromPool selects two different identities without replacement once, then ordinary entry/quantity/capacity. After both original entries, capture all current friendly named dormant seed instances and advance each original countdown once.
policies.shellshot: One actual CAST; each step queries new active living enemy minions and current actual-cast Spell Damage. Positive base3+bonus-step is handed to ordinary SPELL damage with its bonus already included; ordinary multipliers/routing/shields/deaths apply and next step follows their checkpoint.

uncertainties: Dead-Beast tribe changes, same-ID multiple death weighting/material preference and exact CN discovery/quantity windows retain explicit existing local policies.

Shellshot bonus changes during reactions and multipliers after the repeat-count number are local uncalibrated policies; ordinary bonus increases repeat count, immunity/prevention does not stop a positive-number chain.
Wildseed membership and names follow fixed original rows plus complete primary bilingual token faces; precise awaken/extra-summon timing and RNG capacity policy remain existing local behavior.
No formal full-pool, hotfix or CN edge calibration claim.
